highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews Skia m153, including upstream rendering fixes and updated Linux font fallback behavior.
highlights_body: Applications that require consistent Linux font selection should use an explicit family and style or bundle the required typeface.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style, or a bundled typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153 and incorporates the latest upstream Chrome m153 rendering fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and current upstream rendering fixes.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It incorporates current upstream rendering fixes and may select a different Linux font fallback face. Use an explicit family and style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters.
